title: Chapter 27 Continental History
content:
Chapter 27 Continental History

Zhong Yu's Luoyang City has boundless forests to the east and south. In addition to the endless beasts, it is the legendary elves living in the depths of the forest.

Those elf legends once ruled the entire Alam Continent. They are handsome in appearance, long in life and outstanding in cultivation talent. He is born with powerful magical abilities, and can control all kinds of plants, and many kinds of powerful monsters, all get along very well, and can summon them to help him fight.

However, the way of heaven revolves, the cycle is endless, from public to private. Since God has given them such outstanding talents, it must have deprived them of something vital.

They have a long and incalculable lifespan, and their natural fertility is very low. Except at the beginning, when the foundation was founded, the population increased very rapidly, reaching one million people.

When I arrived at the unified Alam Continent, I destroyed any enemy, enslaved all races under my feet, and the strength of my own group was unprecedentedly powerful, with thousands of fourth-order powerhouses, hundreds of fifth-order powerhouses, and more. There are countless soldiers of all ranks.

This kind of strength is enough to suppress any race, and within their clan, the gods they believe in are the three powerful gods, the moon god Anilul, the forest god Frida, and the elf god Neil, plus some other comparisons of different strengths. A weak god is enough to deter all gods from daring to act rashly.

The long Elf Era on the continent began, which lasted for 10,000 years. A long period of ease and peace has swept away the vigilance of all elves and their fighting spirit. So they have started to seek love, freedom, art, music, and other things to play with despair.

They neglected the study of magic and the practice of bow and arrow skills. All kinds of capitals that make a living and living are abandoned by them, and they are called barbarism and vulgarity.

Constantly seek the so-called love, and never marry for the loyalty of love. A lot of resources are expended for the so-called art, because this exploits the race they rule, killing countless lives.

The seeds of hatred were planted at that time, and they continued to take root and sprout, growing into a towering tree that was unshakable.

The elves who sat down and whitewashed the peace, did not find that a race that was constantly advancing in strength, the human beings, was quietly and rapidly rising.

The strength has reached a certain level, but it suffers from not having more sites and resources to support its further consumption. I have to look at the overlord of this continent, and now they have developed a strong race - elves.

Knowing that his strength is not enough, he is still very weak compared to that huge empire. The human leaders at that time were constantly seeking more races, and everyone united to overthrow the brutal rule of the elves and obtain more survival resources.

After a hundred years of accumulation and preparation, all the plans were gradually perfected to the point of launching a war.

Humans, dwarves, and orcs have three powerful races with large populations as the backbone, and hundreds of races with smaller numbers and weaker strengths as the branches. An army of hundreds of millions of people gathered together and attacked the entire elf tribe overwhelmingly.

The elves, whose souls were corrupted by long-term comfort, were caught off guard, and a large number of people were wiped out at once, and the number of casualties reached more than 200,000.

Those in the clan couldn't let go of the pride in their hearts and insisted on the so-called glory of the elf clan. The kidnappers, the entire race, resisted hard for a while.

The number of casualties has increased significantly again. In the past, even if they participated in a rebellion and overthrew the king's rule, they would not bear to execute an elves.

At this time, it was meaninglessly consumed in that impossible war. Thousands of elves died on the battlefield every day, after a year of persistent resistance.

The population of the entire ethnic group dropped to less than 200,000, and a large number of strong people died on the battlefield. Because of the war, a large number of newborns were killed by vile raiders.

There are only old people and young warriors left in the entire ethnic group. Without a single child, even the old people were assassinated by all the hostile races because they did not have enough strength to protect themselves. The 10% that came down was also because of its relatively strong strength and ability to protect itself.

Just after the entire elves lost their old people and children, the population also dropped to the brink of extinction.

Guided by the gods of the elves, a meeting unfolded around the future fate of the elves. Due to the powerful strength of the elf gods, they were afraid that they would break the jar and pull all races to perish together.

Even if the power of the elf gods is above the mainland of Alam, because of the suppression of the will of the world, they cannot exert too strong power on the mainland, but even if this power is not too strong, it is not the ability of those mortals on the mainland. resisted.

Therefore, the gods of various races reached a unified will. The elves retreated from the center of the continent to the surrounding areas of the continent, the southwestern basin, the southern mountains, the southeastern forests, and the eastern grasslands. The places they used to look down on were now the places where they would settle down in the future.

And the races of the elves who have defeated have moved to the center of the continent together, and the fast fertile land is enough to support countless races and countless populations.

However, all this is not the end. Humans who have obtained more resources and land are not satisfied with sharing the center of the continent with other kinds of food when their strength has been more and more developed.

They provoked the war between dwarves and orcs through conspiracy, and dragged other races into this vortex, while they themselves were on the sidelines, watching the war between the two races from the other side.

After several years of war, all the two races were severely damaged, but at this moment, human beings showed their fangs. The army, which had been prepared for a long time, attacked the major races, destroying them one by one, or expelling them, or surrendering.

The dwarves were driven to the mountains to the south, and the basins to the southwest. And was driven together with the local elves to form an alliance to jointly defend against the human attack.

The orcs were driven to the deserts and Gobi in the northwest, suffering from hunger and sandstorms all the year round. Other races were also wiped out, leaving very few.

After the human beings expelled all the enemies, they also broke out a brutal civil war because of the dispute of power.

And the level of social civilization of that part of the people, because of the cruel living environment, continued to degenerate, and slowly evolved into a large race with completely different living habits - barbarians.

That is, Zhong Yu is now surrounded by countless, completely staying in the race of primitive tribal civilization.

Those elves, because the war has passed for only three thousand years, you are only three generations of them with a long life span of a thousand years.

The wounds of the war are far from healed, and the population is estimated to have not recovered much. At most, it is only about 300,000 people. For the entire continent with a population of 1 billion, an army of tens of millions, and all kinds of talents emerging in an endless stream of human beings, is far from enough to see.

So they can only say that they are in the corner, licking their wounds and not daring to come out. In order to avoid entering the abyss of war again, unable to extricate themselves, and eventually leading to destruction.

In the past so many years, there have been countless wars between barbarians, and no elves have come out to join in, which is the proof.
